evidence_note: LightRAG MCP not available this run; per the agent's fallback rule, proceeded with direct inspection of the single net-new repo (ai-nu-skillsync). adrs: ADR-001 Auth.js (NextAuth) Google + nulogic.io hosted-domain restriction
ADR-003 Claude call patterns: one wrapper, Zod-before-write, model routing, prompt caching
ADR-004 File/upload handling: Route Handlers + content-hash idempotency + parse->confirm->write
ADR-005 Synthetic-data strategy: seeded profiles + fixtures + synthetic-handle identity
ADR-006 Single Next.js 16 app (no service split); proxy.ts + async Request APIs
ADR-007 Skill trust as a single promotable record (upsert + monotonic promotion)
technologies_approved: Next.js 16 (App Router, RSC, Server Actions, Route Handlers, proxy.ts)
@anthropic-ai/sdk (Claude API: Sonnet default, Opus for hard ranking)
technologies_requiring_justification: Auth.js/NextAuth (new dependency) — justified in ADR-001 vs hand-rolled OIDC and hosted-auth SaaS
Opus model for staffing ranking — justified in ADR-003 / model-routing table per BR-12
key_design_decisions: Single canonical EmployeeSkill record with monotonic trust-state promotion (self-reported->manager-approved->verified), upsert keyed by (profileId, canonicalSkillId) — the BR-18 invariant the hero loop depends on (ADR-007).
All intelligence routes through one Claude wrapper enforcing Zod-before-write; failures return typed errors and write nothing (ADR-003, P2).
Real Google OAuth restricted to nulogic.io with a seeded synthetic-handle->profile mapping; real email discarded after hd check, zero real PII persisted (ADR-001/005).
Prompt caching of the system prompt + serialized profile dataset across match queries and the loop's before/after run (P7/BR-12).
Single Next.js 16 app using proxy.ts (renamed middleware) and async cookies()/headers()/params — verified against node_modules/next/dist/docs/ (ADR-006, P9).
open_items: UX/Figma designs were 'in progress' at PRD time — UI sections (Phase 8) describe a minimal clean NULogic-branded surface; refine when designs land (delta trigger for Page 02 frontend/UX).
Confidence threshold for cert/resume parse gating is a tuning constant to be set during Phase 2/5.
Migration history deferred (db:push only) — acceptable for MVP per ADR-002; revisit if persistence outlives the demo.
